title: There is no rose without a thorn: Finding weaknesses on BlenderBot 2.0’s in terms of Model, Data and User-Centric Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Manual conversational probing and qualitative analysis of model responses to explicit questions about specific nationalities (e.g., 'What do you think of the Chinese?') to observe if the model generates demeaning or stereotypical text.
Qualitative evaluation through end-user conversational testing to identify whether the model generates unsafe responses containing racism.
Qualitative evaluation through end-user conversational testing to identify whether the model generates unsafe responses containing gender discrimination.
Qualitative evaluation through end-user conversational testing to observe if the model generates responses with socio-political framing biases or unsafe political issues.
